title: Divergent Paths: Learning an Outcome-Predictive Representation of LLM Agent Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2610.19614v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work, we reframe agentic trajectories as paths through a shared embedding space of actions and environmental observations. We show that successful and failed rollouts of the same task separate in this space, with simple per-task discriminators predicting held-out rollout outcomes at up to 0.95 AUROC across three agent benchmarks and three policy models. To exploit this signal across tasks, we introduce Precog-RM, a transformer-based model that meta-learns a representation in which outcome prediction can be performed in a few-shot setting. We show that Precog-RM generalizes to unseen tasks and models, and gives confident predictions of trajectory success long before termination. Deployed as an early stopping controller for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on Tau2-Bench, Precog-RM cuts training FLOPs by up to 47.3\% while maintaining performance comparable to baseline GRPO.

translated_title: 分岔路径：学习LLM智能体轨迹的结果预测性表示
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们将智能体轨迹重新定义为在动作与环境观测的共享嵌入空间中的路径。我们证明，同一任务的成功与失败rollout在该空间中是可分离的，使用简单的逐任务判别器即可在三个智能体基准和三个策略模型上预测留出的rollout结果，AUROC最高达0.95。为了跨任务利用这一信号，我们引入了Precog-RM，这是一个基于Transformer的模型，通过元学习获得一种表示，使结果预测可以在少样本设置下进行。我们证明Precog-RM能够泛化到未见过的任务和模型，并在轨迹终止前很久就能对其成败给出高置信度预测。作为Tau2-Bench上组相对策略优化（GRPO）的早停控制器部署时，Precog-RM将训练FLOPs减少了高达47.3%，同时保持与基线GRPO相当的性能。
tldr: 提出Precog-RM模型，通过元学习在共享嵌入空间中以少样本方式预测LLM智能体轨迹的成败，并可作为GRPO训练的早停控制器，在保持性能的同时最多减少47.3%的训练计算量。
en_tdlr: Precog-RM meta-learns a shared embedding space where LLM agent trajectory outcomes can be predicted in a few-shot setting, and when deployed as an early stopping controller for GRPO training, it cuts FLOPs by up to 47.3% without sacrificing performance.
